title: VSift search data, brief view v1
description: The data member of a complete or partial search result asked for with --view brief (0.2.1): search-data.schema.json with each item reduced to transcript-segment-brief.schema.json and a view member that is always brief. The parallel hits (segment_id and how it matched), the normalised query, the requested range, the cursor and transcript_coverage are the full page's own, and the revision block holds once what the full view repeats on every item. Validate the envelope with operation-response.schema.json: its coverage member is truncated, and its status partial, exactly when transcript_coverage.untranscribed_ranges is not empty. The view is refused with --events jsonl. Pass next_cursor back with the same session, query, range and revision to continue; the view is not part of what a cursor binds, so it continues in either view.

screen_text.description: Since 0.3.0 (ADR 0030), on a first page only: the query's occurrences in on-screen text read by ocr, with each hit's frame, time and region, and how much of the searched range's plan is read. Absent on a page a cursor continues and from releases before 0.3.0. It never changes the envelope's status or coverage.
